text:
emily-partnerships: Quick sync  - NovaSI is asking for a single intake for marketplace listing: SOC2 summary, pen-test PDF, and SI integration artifacts. They want our recommended upload flow.

reza-platform: We should ask for presigned sanitized bundle + presigned raw bundle (short TTL). Keep sanitized for catalog ingestion and raw for review.

sophie-legal: Attestation mandatory. Must include pen-tester name, dates, scope summary, and a redaction attestation. Also clause: Redwood not liable for SI-provided customer data unless explicitly declared.

drew-sec: Security note: Require manifest.sha256, scope.txt listing CIDRs/assets, and a redaction log file. Pen reports often have IPs and private hostnames. We'll need a redaction proof (diff or redaction.log).

marta-marketing: Please add press_embargo field. NovaSI requested embargo till 2026-04-20. Also indicate whether they want co-marketing.

marketplace-bot: Intake policy: evidence_ingest_v2 fields required: attestation.pdf, manifest.sha256, scope.txt, sanitized.tar.gz, raw_presign_url (ttl 12h). Include contains_firmware:true/false and press_embargo:YYYY-MM-DD.

emily-partnerships: Plan: send partner wrapper script that validates manifest and uploads to presigned URLs. Schedule 30min witness call with pen-test firm to confirm redaction. Can someone own scheduling?

reza-platform: I'll produce the wrapper + small lambda to verify sha256 and required files, and flag artifact as partner-managed to prevent auto-publish until legal signs off. Example presign command we send to partners.

sophie-legal: I'll prepare attestation template and add retention language for SI artifacts. Ask partners to declare any third-party customer data in attachments.

drew-sec: I'll prepare a redaction checklist and join the witness call. Record the call for audit and store link in the ticket.

emily-partnerships: Summary actions: reza -> wrapper & presign; sophie -> attestation; drew -> redaction checklist & witness; marta -> confirm embargo/marketing. Decision target: Tue EOD, ingest Wed.

marketplace-bot: Created ticket #PART-4621. Reminder: presigned links expire in 12h by default; reissue required after expiry.

emily-partnerships: Thanks all, keeping thread as single source of truth. :white_check_mark:
